GeneralInfo.Name: Backdrop MP 1.39 AnyCPU ALPHA21 Lucide
GeneralInfo.Author: cul8er; local MP 1.39 AnyCPU adaptation
GeneralInfo.ExtensionDescription: Experimental Backdrop 1.0.1 port for MediaPortal 1.39. Includes an AnyCPU menu editor. Tested on x64; full x86 runtime testing remains pending. Requires compatible external Fanart Handler and Latest Media Handler plugins. See README.md and docs/VALIDATION.md.
GeneralInfo.VersionDescription: ALPHA21: consistent music menu frames and text alignment; padded plugin rows and one visible entry per plugin. Includes architecture-aware single EXE setup.
